sources.title: Introducing Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2
sources.evidence: September 11, 2026 announcement explicitly releases Ultra v2 via API that day. Describes a performance-focused orchestration configuration over open and specialized workers, separate from Max. No exact learned-weight count or backbone topology is given.

sources.title: Sakana API models and endpoints
sources.evidence: Current models table binds fugu-ultra to fugu-ultra-v2.0. Documents fixed Ultra worker pool, reasoning controls, text responses, tool definitions/tool_choice, and built-in web search. Model details describe the composed service, not a single neural checkpoint.

sources.title: Pinned official integration model catalog
sources.evidence: Entry slug fugu-ultra is explicitly named Fugu Ultra v2.0. It specifies context_window 1000000, text/image input, high/xhigh reasoning and parallel tool-call support. This is a client API contract, not model weights/configuration.

sources.title: Sakana AI API Platform Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Service/configuration intellectual property remains with Sakana and relevant licensors. Permission is limited to use of the service; no right to redistribute model weights is granted.

sources.title: Sakana Fugu Technical Report, June revision
sources.evidence: Original Ultra section3.2 describes language-model orchestration, GRPO, worker communication and persistent memory. The June paper predates September Ultra v2; its original worker pool and training setup cannot establish v2 specifications. No exact v2 backbone/count is supplied.

sources.title: Sakana Fugu report revision history
sources.evidence: Submitted June19 and last revised June23, 2026. The arXiv suffix v2 identifies the paper revision, not the September Fugu Ultra v2 model.

sources.title: Gemma 4-based Fugu orchestration experiment
sources.evidence: August10 research identifies prior Fugu orchestrators as Qwen-based without exact version/size and tests a Gemma4 E2B alternative. It predates Ultra v2 and does not bind that experimental backbone to the later deployed variant.

sources.title: Recursive self-improvement through multi-agent self-supervision
sources.evidence: Later October research trains a shared Qwen3.6-27B model in a separate recursive self-improvement experiment. It does not identify that model as Ultra v2 or supply an exact Ultra v2 comparison count.

sources.title: Sakana Chat update: Fugu Max and memory
sources.evidence: September17 update concerns Fugu Max in Sakana Chat. Chat attachments and memory are application features, not proof of Ultra v2 neural modalities or backbone.

sources.title: Official repository inventory
sources.evidence: Complete, nontruncated tree contains integration configuration, scripts, demos and a technical report, with no distributed neural checkpoint. Official SakanaAI Hugging Face fugu search also returned an empty list.

sources.title: Sakana AI research and product archive
sources.evidence: Reviewed later product/research leads, including September Chat update and October MASS work. No exact Ultra v2 learned-weight count or neural configuration was found in these accessed sources.

name.note: Official release name; direct API identifier is fugu-ultra-v2.0.

developer.note: Sakana develops the orchestrator; its worker models may have different developers.

family.note: Normalized Fugu product family, distinct from a claim about underlying backbone lineage.

release_date.note: Dated announcement explicitly states immediate API availability. June original Ultra and July v1.1 are earlier revisions.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary release. Public integration code and open worker models do not distribute the complete Ultra v2 orchestrator/system weights.

license.note: Classification of the hosted service; no worker, client repository or paper license is transferred to the model.

parameters_b.note: No exact deployed orchestrator or full-system total is disclosed in checked first-party material. Earlier Qwen lineage, Gemma4 E2B experiment and MASS27B model are not exact v2 parameter evidence. No public checkpoint permits reconstruction.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token learned-weight count or counting convention is disclosed. Independently invoked workers and orchestration token usage do not establish a scalar active parameter count.

architecture.note: Learned multi-model orchestration is documented, but exact v2 backbone neural topology is undisclosed. A worker pool is not a neural mixture-of-experts checkpoint. June report GRPO and August Qwen lineage cannot be asserted as exact September v2 architecture.

context_window.note: Official v2.0 integration entry advertises 1,000,000 tokens. This is composed-service context capacity, not proof that the orchestrator or every worker natively supports that length.

modalities.note: Verified text/image input and text response interface. PDF is a file container rather than a separate neural modality; no native PDF encoder is established. Service image support does not establish a vision encoder inside the orchestrator.

reasoning.note: Exact v2.0 entry supports high/xhigh; API documents max as an alias of xhigh and exposes reasoning controls. This describes the composed service.

tool_call.note: Model-selected function tools/tool_choice and built-in web search are documented, with parallel calls enabled. Internal orchestration and external caller-executed function calls are distinct.

description.value: Orchestration model that coordinates a fixed pool of worker models for complex reasoning, research and software tasks.
description.note: Replaces promotional quality framing with documented purpose and fixed worker-pool behavior, without assigning unsupported benchmark superiority or architecture.

patch.notes: Released September 11, 2026 as Fugu Ultra v2; the direct identifier is fugu-ultra-v2.0 and current fugu-ultra aliases it. The 1,000,000-token context, text/image input, reasoning and tool calls describe the composed API service. Its worker pool is fixed for standard users but can evolve between releases; it is not a neural MoE parameter count. Exact total/active parameters and backbone topology remain undisclosed. The June technical report revision v2 describes original Ultra, not September Ultra v2. Earlier Qwen lineage, the Gemma4 E2B validation and later Qwen3.6-27B MASS research are not exact deployed-backbone evidence. No authenticated inference was performed.

summary: Confirmed the exact September11 release and current v2.0 alias binding, 1M service context, text/image input, reasoning and tool calling. Added Proprietary, removed PDF as a separate neural modality, and clarified the orchestration description. Total/active counts and neural topology remain undisclosed after variant-specific release/docs and earlier/later technical research checks.
